# Frozen regression baselines

These 34 source fixtures originate at the directory revisions. Owner-approved pre-publication data replacement changes only their embedded sample payloads: fully synthetic, generated by scripts/generate_sample.py (seed 731209). Historical engine code is retained byte-for-byte; data-bearing fixtures are explicitly sanitized rather than exact historical bytes.
`manifest.json` records their SHA-256 digests. No current-engine substitutes are accepted.
Python (`tests/baseline.py`) and Node (`tests/baseline.mjs`) prefer fixtures and fall back to
`git show` only for unvendored revisions. Existing source labels and assertions remain unchanged.
The former `connect-design` schema reference is pinned to `342cd4a76d63dcd4b8d7abe12118287cc7b2314b`.
Backend guard checkpoints: engine `f2509b4`; authorized CLI byte-cap loader/source `74572d6`.
Regenerate only with explicit authorization; compare engine code with its original Git object and data-bearing payloads with the seeded generator.
